$comment: Known short names for brands whose Qloo name is longer or different (Part 9 open issue 5, PLAN D20 alias exception). The resolution gate treats a /search result as an exact match when the question's mention, normalised, equals `alias` and the result's normalised name equals one of `names` with entity type `type`; the resolve event then says "Read 'KFC' as 'Kentucky Fried Chicken'". Only `verified` entries apply. Names are public brand names (D29 allows names), never ids or Qloo values. `pnpm exec tsx tools/dev/brand-aliases.ts check --yes` runs each alias through the same cached brand /search the gate uses (at most one call each, under QLOO_TAG and its caps) and rewrites `status` and `verified_by`: verified when one of `names` comes back for the alias, unverified otherwise. Re-run it after editing this file or when Qloo's catalogue changes. An alias whose candidate is a different company or product line (Coty and Coty Airspun, Marriott International and Marriott Hotels) or a short name that is ambiguous on its own (Columbia, Coors) is left out on purpose: it would read one thing as another.
